impacts.reason: The scenario preconditions (non-zero launchpad fees, direct mint without pre-transfer) directly enable the free-mint theft described, and both explicit intents state that fees must not be counted as minted-in liquidity / LP tokens must not be mintable for free, directly concerning theft of funds.
